_help: Linux/macOS version — see svg-preview.windows.json for Windows. Same resvg tool, but some Linux distro packages install its binary as rendersvg instead of resvg (check which one is actually on PATH; adjust "cmd" if your distro differs). Preview generator config — see docs/generators.md for the full guide. Waydir ignores every key starting with "_" when loading.
_help_cmd: The executable to run — must be on PATH, or an absolute path. Some distros name it resvg instead; `which rendersvg resvg` to check which one you actually have.
_help_args: resvg/rendersvg <in-svg> <out-png>, with --width fixing the output width while preserving the SVG's own aspect ratio. Background stays transparent since outputExt is png.
